agencyName: Arkansas Department of Labor and Licensing, Board of Electrical Examiners
authorityRationale: The Board of Electrical Examiners' own licensing page — the only source for the exact Journeyman and Master reciprocal-agreement state lists, the asymmetric Master-reciprocates-as-Journeyman rule (except Oregon and North Dakota), and the Wyoming apprenticeship-hours condition. This content is not present in the codified administrative rules text (17 CAR Part 210); it is the Board's own maintained reciprocal-agreements roster.
reliabilityRationale: Official, live Board of Electrical Examiners page — directly analogous to the Colorado DORA Applications page (colorado-electrical-board-applications) already used as the primary source for Colorado's exact reciprocal-state list.
